text_block_list.text:
During training, Neo Universe got injured, 
so we came to the nurse's office to treat 
it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Thrust" is decaying... Even so, Neo 
Universe can "run."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The situation is "controllable." There are 
no "concerns"... right.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure you get proper rest for 
now.
...Only if you promise not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Even so, we should prepare for the worst.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In the unlikely event... The probability 
is low... Even so, the possibility 
certainly exists...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Affirmative. The probability of 
becoming "debris" is not zero.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe will focus on an "overhaul."

To let her injury heal, Neo Universe got 
some rest.

Neo Universe started with light training. 
However……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... "Emergency"... Anomaly 
detected... in the drive unit...

It seems the injury has worsened... Neo 
Universe took a break to rest until the 
injury healed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Condition: 'All Green.' I did a light 
run, and there are no issues with my legs.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The next "training" will also be held in 
"microgravity".

To keep her injury from worsening, Neo 
Universe trained with a lighter load.
